Writes app.R Script

Source: R/generateShinyApp.R
preprocessing_write_app_file.Rd

This function writes a static app.R script using the provided data objects, matching the current example output of generateShinyApp.

Usage

preprocessing_write_app_file(
  app_dir,
  run_enrichment = FALSE,
  run_autocorrelation = FALSE,
  run_pixel_enrichment = FALSE,
  has_multi_modal = FALSE,
  has_pathway_table = FALSE,
  has_pathway_classification = FALSE,
  multi_modal_path = NULL
)

Arguments

app_dir

Directory to write the app.R file

run_enrichment

Logical; whether to include enrichment panel

run_autocorrelation

Logical; whether to include autocorrelation panel

run_pixel_enrichment

Logical; whether to include pixel enrichment panel

has_multi_modal

Logical; whether multi-modal data is present

has_pathway_table

Logical; whether pathway table is present

has_pathway_classification

Logical; whether pathway classification table is present

multi_modal_path

Path to multi-modal data file (optional)

Value

Path to the written app.R file
